The error likely due to invalid SMILES (maybe aromatic fused ring not correct). We need correct product SMILES. Could use the original product side from mapped_rxn but without mapping. Let's extract more carefully.

Original product side (after >>):

[CH3:1][C:2]([CH3:3])([CH3:4])[O:5][C:6](=[O:7])[N:8]1[CH2:9][CH2:10][N:11]([c:12]2[cH:13][c:14]([N+:15](=[O:16])[O-:17])[cH:18][c:19]3[c:20]2[O:21][C:22]2([CH2:23][CH2:24][CH2:25]2)[CH2:26][CH2:27]3)[CH2:28][CH2:29]1

We need to convert to proper SMILES. Let's stepwise.

Fragment A: t-butyl ester: [CH3][C]([CH3])([CH3])O C(=O) N1...

So "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1". Good.

Then inside ring: N1[CH2][CH2][N]... [CH2][CH2]1 forms piperazine: N1CCN(... )CC1.

Thus after N1 we have "CCN(... )CC1". So far: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(... )CC1".

Now the substituent on that N (the second N) is the aromatic fused system.

The aromatic part: [c:12]2[cH:13][c:14]([N+:15](=[O:16])[O-:17])[cH:18][c:19]3[c:20]2[O:21][C:22]2([CH2:23][CH2:24][CH2:25]2)[CH2:26][CH2:27]3

Let's decode: start with aromatic carbon c12 with ring index 2: c2

Then [cH:13] is aromatic carbon with H, attached to previous, no index: c

Then [c:14] with nitro substituent: c( [N+](=O)[O-] )

Then [cH:18] aromatic carbon with H: c

Then [c:19]3 aromatic carbon with ring index 3: c3

Then [c:20]2 aromatic carbon that closes to ring 2: c2 (so fused)

Then [O:21] O attached to that aromatic carbon.

Then [C:22]2 ... this is aliphatic carbon with ring index 2 (new ring). So O-C2(... )...

Inside parentheses: ([CH2:23][CH2:24][CH2:25]2) meaning a three-carbon chain that closes ring 2: C C C2 (so a cyclobutane? Actually C2 start, then three CH2 then close to same index 2 forms a cyclobutane? Let's see: C2(CCC2) is a cyclobutane fused to O? So O-C2(CCC2) is a cyclobutane attached to O.

After that, [CH2:26] C attached to C22 (outside ring) then [CH2:27]3 C that closes to ring 3.

Thus the fused system is a benzodioxepane? Anyway.

So the aromatic SMILES: c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3

Let's write: c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3

Combine: c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3

Remove spaces: c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3 -> "c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3". Need proper: "c2c c([N+](=O)[O-])c c3c2OC2(CCC2)C3". Actually correct SMILES: "c2c([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)C3". Let's verify: start c2, then c([N+](=O)[O-]) (that's c with nitro), then c c3 (two consecutive aromatic carbons, second opens ring 3), then c2 (closes to ring 2), then O C2(CCC2) C3 (closing ring 3). So final: "c2c([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)C3". That seems plausible.

Thus full product SMILES: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2c([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)C3)CC1"

Now apply template again.
